location.site_description: Las Colinas redevelopment site; city and company records describe an approximately 50-acre campus.

status_as_of_cutoff: site work-construction as of 2026-08-11: official state TDLR record TABS2025013924 registers a new-construction 300,000 SF, 65 MW core-and-shell data center at 111 Customer Way with a 2025-09-23 start date and 2026-08-14 completion date, PowerHouse/AREP current pages list campus construction/delivery from Q1 2025 to Q1 2027, and DCD reported on 2026-03-30 that the first Irving building had topped out with interior systems and infrastructure work continuing. No certificate of occupancy, final inspection, utility energization, commissioned-load, or live-service evidence was located.
evidence_grade: B - state TDLR registration plus city agenda/process records and current owner/developer pages; construction status supported by industry report, but no CO or energization record found

actions.government_body: City of Irving Planning and Zoning Commission
actions.action_type: planning agenda - comprehensive plan amendment and zoning case
actions.result_status: Agenda listed Comprehensive Plan Amendment Case #2023-87-CP for AREP SOF III Las Colinas LLC at 111 Customer Way, approximately 50.21 acres, changing the plan category from Compact Neighborhood to Manufacturing/Warehouse; it also listed Zoning Case #2023-86-ZC to establish required parking for a data center, both scheduled for the January 25, 2024 City Council public hearing.
actions.access_caveat: Agenda listing establishes local process but not final approval by itself.

actions.action_type: tax abatement reinvestment zone and tax abatement agreement agenda
actions.result_status: Council agenda item ID #14591 described designating about 50.0276 acres at 111 Customer Way as Tax Abatement Reinvestment Zone No. 60 for Powerhouse Data LCX, LLC; item ID #14502 described a tax abatement agreement requiring purchase by 2024-09-30, demolition of the existing warehouse, one 2-story 300,000 SF data center building by 2026-12-31, and additional 300,000 SF buildings by 2029-12-31 and 2030-12-31.
actions.case_or_ordinance_permit_number: ID #14591; ID #14502; Tax Abatement Reinvestment Zone No. 60
actions.access_caveat: Muyni is an independent archive of the Irving agenda and links to the official PrimeGov agenda; the official agenda link was not retrievable through the browser session.
actions.evidence_note: Used for city economic-development terms and phasing, not as proof of construction completion.

actions.result_status: PowerHouse and Harrison Street announced completed land purchase of a 50-acre Irving-Las Colinas site at 111 Customer Way for PowerHouse Irving, a nearly 1 million SF campus delivering 200 MW when complete, with three powered-shell data centers totaling over 946,000 SF and 67 MW per building; construction was then scheduled to begin in early 2025.
actions.access_caveat: Company announcement; not a government permit, inspection, CO, or energization record.
actions.evidence_note: Establishes campus identity, address, initial capacity framing, and sponsor/developer.

actions.government_body: Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation
actions.result_status: TDLR TABS2025013924 registered AREP Powerhouse Las Colinas / Power House Data Center at 111 Customer Way as privately funded new construction with a 2025-09-23 start date, 2026-08-14 completion date, $47 million estimated cost, 300,000 SF scope, and 65 MW total load. Current status is Review Complete.
actions.access_caveat: TDLR architectural barriers registration is not a local building permit, certificate of occupancy, or utility energization record.
actions.evidence_note: Best official project-specific construction-registration record located in this refresh.

actions.result_status: DCD reported PowerHouse had topped out the first building at the Irving campus and that work continued on interior systems, infrastructure, and later campus phases.
actions.access_caveat: Industry media report citing company social post; not a permit, inspection, CO, or energization record.
actions.evidence_note: Used with TDLR/company timeline to classify the project as site work-construction.

actions.result_status: Current PowerHouse and AREP property pages list PowerHouse Irving at 111 Customer Way as a 50-acre, 946,200 SF, up-to-three-building campus with maximum utility power of 201 MW; PowerHouse lists delivery Q1 2026, construction/delivery Q1 2025-Q1 2027, and power delivery Q1 2026.
actions.access_caveat: Current marketing/property page; no CO, final inspection, energization, commissioned-load, or live-service record was located.
actions.evidence_note: Current company page supports campus scale and 201 MW maximum utility power.

owner: American Real Estate Partners / PowerHouse Data Centers; developed with Harrison Street. City incentive records use Powerhouse Data LCX, LLC.

project_details.utility_service_note: PowerHouse announcement says the site has immediate access to permanent power from an existing adjacent substation serviced by Oncor; no Oncor interconnection, energization, or commissioned-load record was located.

sources.match_reason: Seed-only record matched to PowerHouse/AREP/TDLR/city records at 111 Customer Way, Irving, TX.

contradictions.description: The May 15, 2024 PowerHouse announcement describes a 200 MW campus and three buildings at 67 MW each, while current PowerHouse/AREP property pages list maximum utility power as 201 MW. TDLR's first registered building scope lists 65 MW.
contradictions.resolution: Adopted 201 MW as the current campus maximum utility power; retained 200 MW announcement and 65 MW first-building registration in actions/project_details.

contradictions.description: PowerHouse's current page lists Delivery Q1 2026 and power delivery Q1 2026, but TDLR lists completion 2026-08-14 for the first 300,000 SF / 65 MW registration, the company page also shows construction/delivery Q1 2025-Q1 2027, and the 2026-03-30 DCD report says interior systems and infrastructure work were still continuing after topping out.
contradictions.resolution: Classified as site work-construction, not energized or live, because no CO, final inspection, utility energization, commissioned-load, or live-service evidence was located.

history.new_value: site work-construction as of 2026-08-11 based on TDLR registration, current company timeline, and DCD topping-out report; no CO/energization/live evidence located.
